markdown: **Activate** <actions string="Two Actions" /> manipulate, Interact;     **Effect** You whip the fortune cord, causing 10 coins loaded onto it to detach and fire at a creature within 100 feet that you can see. That creature takes 4d6 damage (DC 28 basic Reflex save); the damage type depends on the type of coins you've loaded. Copper coins deal acid damage, silver coins deal electricity damage, gold coins deal fire damage, and platinum coins deal cold damage.
